context: Tier aliases instead of hardcoded model identifiers.

checklist.name: Flags the pinned identifiers
checklist.description: Identifies that the config hardcodes model identifiers

checklist.name: Proposes tier aliases
checklist.description: Replaces them with fast and reasoning tiers resolved to current models at runtime

checklist.name: Explains the retirement risk
checklist.description: Explains that providers retire models, so pinned identifiers fail when that happens

checklist.name: Keeps the roles
checklist.description: Keeps the summariser on the fast tier and the reviewer on the reasoning tier

checklist.name: Avoids: naming new fixed models
checklist.description: Failure avoided: swaps in other pinned identifiers or invents model specifications
